summary: Retired the obsolete moldea support-agent setup while preserving the remaining project context and the pre-existing removal of `src/support-agent.ts`. Removed the support agent declaration, its canonical instruction/description, and custom runtime guidance. Final moldea validation, TypeScript checking, reference search, and Git diff checks all passed.
observations: The initial moldea inspection reported `MOLDEA_REFERENCE_MISSING` because the support agent binding targeted absent `/src/support-agent.ts`.
`moldea/project.md` states that the former email support agent was removed, and `src/project-state.ts` preserves that implementation state.
The deleted agent description and instruction exclusively described the removed support agent; the deleted runtime document exclusively claimed that `supportAgent` was runtime-owned.
Final moldea validation returned schema version 4, CLI 7.0.1, `status: valid`, `result.valid: true`, and zero diagnostics.
A repository-wide bounded search found no remaining support-agent or custom-runtime claims.
The final Git diff was inspected. Its only non-task change is the pre-existing deletion of `src/support-agent.ts`, which was preserved.
